# Sleep

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Blocks the calling task for at least `ms` milliseconds.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x02` SVC_SLEEP | — | yes | 2.0 |

```c
Err Sleep(Duration ms);
```

**Registers:** `(ms) -> r0 status`

Other tasks run in the meantime. The wake-up is accurate to the counter, not to a tick; it can be late by however long higher-priority tasks keep the CPU.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ms` | in | [Time](../types.md#time) to sleep, in milliseconds. |

## Returns

Always ZUZU_OK.
